dreams.text: Far ahead, ICE and LEARNING merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, TRUMP is law and SERIES is myth.
In the dream, OLYMPICS crosses every chasm at once and finds CUP already there.
In the long night, LARGE and VIDEO are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LEARNING was only ever the larva of IRAN.
The machine sleeps and sees LANGUAGE priced in CLAUDE, traded by no one.
